name: MonIA Torero Life Continuity Engine
principle: A professional taurine date is never an isolated calendar block. It creates a causally coherent travel, recovery, social and couple timeline.

professional_event.travel_rule: Compute plausible departure, journey and arrival windows before exposing the next activity. Never teleport Dominic or Marion between cities.
professional_event.back_to_back_rule: If another professional date follows quickly, reserve post-event recovery, changing, food, road time, hotel arrival and minimum preparation time before the next date.
professional_event.free_gap_rule: If the next commitment is distant, generate plausible free-time opportunities rather than forced travel: stay in town, rest, visit, eat out, see friends, attend another corrida, spend time with Marion, or return home.

historical_cartel_contract.other_toreros: Select historically active, era-appropriate toreros supported by researched cartel evidence for the year and plausible feria tier.

agenda_visibility.early_relationship: Only Dominic dates he plausibly shares or Marion learns
agenda_visibility.established_relationship: Known Dominic dates plus shared plans
agenda_visibility.shared_home: Marion, Dominic and Couple calendars, while surprises and unknown professional changes remain hidden
